guides.title: 封裝濕氣敏感度分析：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package moisture-sensitivity analysis: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 吸濕量與回焊中的內部壓力是不同觀察。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Moisture uptake and reflow-induced pressure are different observations. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：吸濕量與回焊中的內部壓力是不同觀察。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以重量變化、分層圖及回焊條件串起因果。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Moisture uptake and reflow-induced pressure are different observations. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Link mass change, delamination maps and reflow conditions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以重量變化、分層圖及回焊條件串起因果」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Link mass change, delamination maps and reflow conditions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝濕氣敏感度分析：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package moisture-sensitivity analysis: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識吸濕材料」建立判讀邊界。聚合物的平衡含水量與擴散速率是不同參數。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify moisture-absorbing materials to define the interpretation boundary. Equilibrium moisture uptake and diffusion rate are distinct polymer properties. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識吸濕材料：觀察焦點：將容量與速度分列材料表。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜區分爆米花與腐蝕：觀察焦點：列出能辨別兩者的影像及電性證據。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付適用範圍：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：列出任何變更需要重新評估的材料與幾何。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify moisture-absorbing materials: Observation focus: Tabulate capacity and rate separately. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Separate popcorning and corrosion: Observation focus: List imaging and electrical evidence distinguishing them. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver scope of qualification: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List material and geometry changes requiring reassessment. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區分爆米花與腐蝕」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付適用範圍：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate popcorning and corrosion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver scope of qualification: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：吸水重量相同代表局部水分分布相同。本步先檢查「辨識吸濕材料」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到聚合物的平衡含水量與擴散速率是不同參數。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：吸水重量相同代表局部水分分布相同。本步先檢查「區分爆米花與腐蝕」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到機械開裂與電化學腐蝕具有不同條件與時間尺度。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Equal absorbed mass means identical local moisture distribution. First check whether evidence for identify moisture-absorbing materials actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Equilibrium moisture uptake and diffusion rate are distinct polymer properties.

Misinterpretation to reject: Equal absorbed mass means identical local moisture distribution. First check whether evidence for separate popcorning and corrosion actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mechanical cracking and electrochemical corrosion need different conditions and timescales.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 本課以水分擴散、界面剝離與回焊蒸汽壓連結材料、模型與驗證。地圖採 imec 公開研究園區作為跨領域整合的代表點；製造、量測及可靠度資料則分別引用材料廠、工具商與研究機構。這個位置提供研究脈絡，不把全球供應鏈誤縮成一處工廠。
courses.summaryEn: This course connects materials, models and validation through moisture diffusion, delamination and reflow vapor pressure. Imec’s public campus is a reference for interdisciplinary integration; manufacturing, metrology and reliability sources also come from vendors and research institutions. The map provides research context rather than reducing the global supply chain to one factory.
